name: Introl S.A.
summary: Introl S.A., founded in Katowice, Poland in 1990 (and known as Introl-Polon Sp. z o.o. until its renaming in 1997), operates as a comprehensive general contractor with projects spanning both Poland and international markets. The company’s core activities encompass several key sectors. In the energy domain, Introl is actively involved in modernizing commercial and thermal power plants, implementing solutions for renewable energy sources and cogeneration systems, and constructing new facilities that generate both electrical and thermal power. These energy solutions primarily serve municipal heat and power plants, sewage treatment facilities, and coal mines. The company also provides extensive environmental protection services, including water and wastewater treatment, air and exhaust gas purification, and supplying equipment for mechanical waste filtering and sludge processing. Additionally, Introl handles the transportation of industrial materials such as post-production waste, cement, ash, and sand. Introl specializes in industrial automation, developing and deploying advanced process control and monitoring systems, manufacturing automated stations, modernizing existing production lines, and offering ongoing maintenance services for industrial plants. This is further complemented by its role in distributing control and measurement equipment and designing and implementing intricate measurement systems. Furthermore, Introl extends its expertise to smart building infrastructure, where it designs, implements, integrates, and maintains various low-current systems, including telecommunications, safety, automation, and power systems. The company also delivers comfort systems, designing and constructing sophisticated ventilation and air-conditioning solutions for commercial and office buildings, as well as specialized high-end systems for industrial facilities and power plants. Completing its diverse portfolio, Introl S.A. manufactures a range of specialized industrial components, such as pressure castings, standard and custom temperature sensors, pressure molds, dies, and machining tools.
